title: VerTox: Verifiable Reward-Guided Corpus Poisoning Against Neural Ranking Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.01325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural ranking models have become core components of modern information retrieval systems and important building blocks of AI systems such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines. However, their robustness remains insufficiently understood in the presence of large language models (LLMs), which can generate fluent and deceptive content at scale. This work investigates the vulnerability of neural ranking models to corpus poisoning attacks, in which an adversary injects a small number of maliciously crafted documents into the corpus to distort ranking behavior. We propose VerTox, the first framework to formulate corpus poisoning as a verifiable reward-guided reinforcement learning (RLVR) problem. By explicitly coupling ranking distortion with factual corruption through specialized reward shaping, we fine-tune compact LLMs into adversarial generators. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves near-perfect attack success rate

translated_title: VerTox：可验证奖励引导的针对神经排序模型的语料库投毒攻击
translated_abstract: 神经排序模型已成为现代信息检索系统的核心组件，也是检索增强生成（RAG）流水线等人工智能系统的重要构建模块。然而，在大语言模型（LLM）能够大规模生成流畅且具有欺骗性内容的背景下，这些模型的鲁棒性仍未得到充分理解。本研究探讨了神经排序模型对语料库投毒攻击的脆弱性，此类攻击中，攻击者向语料库注入少量恶意构造的文档以扭曲排序行为。我们提出了VerTox，这是首个将语料库投毒形式化为可验证奖励引导强化学习（RLVR）问题的框架。通过专门的奖励设计将排序扭曲与事实性破坏显式耦合，我们将紧凑型LLM微调为对抗性生成器。实验表明，我们的方法实现了接近完美的攻击成功率。
tldr: 本文提出VerTox，首个将语料库投毒攻击形式化为可验证奖励引导强化学习问题的框架，通过将排序扭曲与事实性破坏耦合的奖励设计将小型LLM微调为对抗性文档生成器，对神经排序模型实现了接近完美的攻击成功率。
en_tdlr: VerTox is the first framework to formulate corpus poisoning as a verifiable reward-guided reinforcement learning (RLVR) problem, fine-tuning compact LLMs into adversarial generators that achieve near-perfect attack success rates against neural ranking models.
